title: Efficient selective hydrogenation of N,N-dimethylaniline in a continuous fixed-bed reactor over a Cu/Ni–Al2O3 catalyst
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,19213-19224
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01119E, Paper
Open Access

Jingdong Nong, Zhonghua Sun, Weiyou Zhou, Zhong Wu, Junfeng Qian, Qun Chen, Mingyang He
An efficient catalytic system based on a copper-doped nickel-alumina catalyst (xCu/Ni–Al2O3) has been developed for the selective hydrogenation of N,N-dimethylaniline (N,N-DMA) to N,N dimethylcyclohexylamine in a continuous fixed-bed reactor.
